title: Sim Live Cell Analysis
tagline: Validate live-cell chromatin-locus analysis against simulated movies where the right answer is known.
about: In a real microscope movie nobody knows the right answer. Here the movie is invented, so we do, and we can measure how much each step of an analysis gets wrong.

The pipeline runs: polymer simulation, then moving cells, then a microscope image model, then segmentation and tracking, then linking each locus to its cell, then analysis, then grading against the known truth.

board.title: Where it stands
board.intro: Green boxes are built and running. Amber boxes work, but stand in for something that still has to be measured or supplied. Grey boxes are planned.

nodes.name: Moving, dividing cells
nodes.note: Cells move, collide, deform, divide and walk in and out of view, with irregular, time-varying nuclear shapes.

nodes.name: Microscope image model
nodes.note: More than 20 switchable error sources (drift, blur, noise, camera defects, stray spots and more), as 2D images or 3D z-stacks.

nodes.name: Segmentation and tracking
nodes.note: Cellpose and Trackastra, scored against the truth with standard tracking metrics plus a count of identity switches.

nodes.name: One movie per cell, analysed in parallel
nodes.note: Each cell is isolated and analysed separately, with several promoter-enhancer copies per cell supported by a multi-copy linker.

nodes.name: Chromatin engine (polychrom)
nodes.note: Checked against published Mirny-lab results. Each cell can be given its own saved simulation; that path has so far been tested with a small test library.

nodes.name: Probe binding, distance-driven transcription and MS2
nodes.note: Transcription bursts respond to the promoter-enhancer distance; the MS2 signal is built from the polymerases on the gene.

nodes.name: Spot finder and MS2 to Pol II deconvolution
nodes.note: A measured placeholder for the lab's own analysis: it finds loci, builds MS2 traces and deconvolves them into polymerase start times (after Chen et al. 2025).

nodes.name: Calibration and error effects
nodes.note: Calibration from the images and from the movie, and a measured effect of each image error with and without its correction.

nodes.name: Do tracking mistakes change the locus results?
nodes.note: Locus results are scored through the tracker's IDs and through the true IDs. Stitching broken tracks is not built yet.

nodes.name: Dashboard and narrated tutorial
nodes.note: Dashboard with players, sweeps and a dark theme, plus the 50-minute tutorial.

nodes.name: Bruker Vutara VXL presets
nodes.note: Widefield and biplane 3D modes, with bleed-through computed from spectra.

nodes.name: Calibrate to a measured MSD
nodes.note: The calibration file exists, but its inputs are assumptions: a single-locus diffusion coefficient, and a 100 kb pair being within 400 nm 10% of the time. They are to be replaced by measured values.

nodes.name: Measured brightness, error sizes and a real movie
nodes.note: MS2 brightness, the size of each image error, and a real movie to compare with.

nodes.name: MS2 as a third witness; sister chromatids

nodes.note: The current spot finder is a stand-in; the real stage 6 analysis is still to come.

nodes.name: Stitch broken tracks
nodes.note: Measuring the effect of tracking mistakes is built; repairing broken tracks is not.
